text: @citisen/dsh-plugin-dev 是一个面向命令行的 DSH 插件开发工具包，通过技能 provider 把开发指南加入 agent 技能目录，并提供五个本地命令。它可以诊断 DSH、配置文件和浏览器环境，组合 profile 并对比基线，启动临时 profile，使用无头浏览器渲染页面并保存截图与控制台错误，也能保存和恢复 profile 配置文件。适合编写或排查 DSH 插件、bundle 与 profile 的开发者。需要 Node.js 20 或更高版本及 DSH 启动器；截图功能还需要 Chromium、Chrome 或 Edge，不要求 API 密钥。

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev helps developers diagnose and test DSH plugins. It adds a guide as an agent skill and provides commands to compare profile configuration, boot a temporary profile, capture browser screenshots and errors, and save or restore profile files. Requires Node.js 20+ and DSH.
想检查 DSH profile 合成后的配置，并和之前保存的基线比较。
我想把 DSH 插件开发环境里的页面渲染成截图，顺便查看控制台错误。
How can I boot a disposable copy of a DSH profile to check a plugin without changing my working profile?
@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev 的功能「profile 配置对比」：通过 DSH 启动器组合指定 profile，输出配置内容，也可保存基线或检查与基线的差异。运行 compose 命令并提供 profile 名称。
@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev 的功能「页面截图与错误采集」：给 shot 命令一个页面 URL 和输出路径，可设置视口、等待条件与颜色方案；命令保存 PNG，并汇总浏览器控制台错误。

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · @citisen/dsh-plugin-dev：Most dsh plugin failures are not code failures. They are **composition** failures
(a row that does not resolve, a patch that replaces a whole `config`, a provider
id that collides) or **client half** failures (a bundle that never mounts). None
of those show up in a unit test, and all of them cost an afternoon when the only
feedback is a broken app.

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · @citisen/dsh-plugin-dev：```sh
dsh-plugin-dev doctor                              # what this machine can test
dsh-plugin-dev compose --profile desktop --json    # the tree the launcher would mount
dsh-plugin-dev shadow  --from desktop --hold       # boot a throwaway copy, print url + token
dsh-plugin-dev shot    --url "$URL" --out shot.png # render it, capture console errors

section: Why a package and not a script
Why a package and not a script

text:
@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · Install：As a bundle, so the agent gets the skill (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @citisen/dsh-plugin-dev
```

The package registers a skill provider, so `dsh-plugin-dev` appears in the agent
catalog. No other profile row is touched, and disabling the bundle removes it
again.

Standalone, for the CLI without the skill:

```sh
npx @citisen/dsh-plugin-dev doctor

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · or：npm i -g @citisen/dsh-plugin-dev
```

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · Commands：| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `doctor` | Detects the launcher and its version, lists profiles, checks whether the chosen profile composes, finds a Chromium |
| `compose` | Composes a profile through the real launcher. `--save` records a baseline, `--check` exits 1 on drift, `--json` lists entries and duplicate ids |
| `shadow` | Copies a profile (files copied, `node_modules` linked), boots it on an OS-assigned port, waits for the URL, probes it, prints url/token/log |
| `shot` | Renders a URL in headless Chromium over CDP: PNG, DOM stats, console errors and uncaught exceptions. `--fail-on-console-error` makes them fatal |
| `snapshot` | Saves, lists and restores the three files that decide a profile's composition. `restore` snapshots the current state first |
@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · Commands：Common flags: `--dsh <path>`, `--json`, `--help`.

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · Requirements：- `dsh` — the desktop application (the bundled CLI is found automatically), the
  published CLI on `PATH`, or `--dsh <path>` / `$DSH_CLI`.
- Node 20+ for the CLI.
- Chromium, Chrome or Edge for `shot` (found automatically; `--browser <path>` or
  `CHROME_PATH` otherwise).
- Windows, macOS and Linux. The desktop app is optional: any `dsh` works.

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · How it works：Nothing is reimplemented. `compose` runs `dsh --profile

--dump-config` and diffs that text; `shadow` runs `dsh --profile --no-open --port 0` and reads the URL the launcher prints; `shot` drives the browser over the DevTools protocol and nothing else. When the launcher refuses the desktop profile, `compose` and `shadow` build a temporary copy under another name — the same workaround a person would do by hand.

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · How it works：The host half is deliberately trivial: it reads `skills/dsh-plugin-dev/SKILL.md`
and registers one skill provider. It cannot fail a profile boot.

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · Version support：Tested with `dsh 0.2.1-rc.2` on Windows 11 (Electron 44 / Node 24.21). The kit
shells out to the launcher, so a version that changes `--dump-config`, the
`dsh web:` boot line, or the desktop-profile policy will surface as a loud error
from `doctor` rather than a silent wrong answer. Please open an issue with the
`doctor --json` output.

@citisen/dsh-plugin-dev README · Contributing：The trap list is the product. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — the short
version is: a step becomes a script on its second manual repetition, and a bug
report becomes an entry in
[`skills/dsh-plugin-dev/references/traps.md`](skills/dsh-plugin-dev/references/traps.md).
